sources.label: Philippine Electrical Code (PEC) 2017 Part 1, Article 2.50 — Lightning Protection Systems
sources.description: Governs lightning protection system design including risk assessment, protection levels, air terminal placement, and grounding requirements.

sources.label: NFPA 780: Standard for the Installation of Lightning Protection Systems
sources.description: International standard referenced in Philippine practice for lightning protection system design and installation.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII — Structural Lightning Protection Requirements
sources.description: Requires lightning protection for buildings exceeding certain height thresholds (typically 15m) and buildings in high lightning density areas.
